event_type.description: Domain event type name (e.g., DELIVERABLE_SUBMITTED, MILESTONE_ACCEPTED)

event_version.description: Version of the event payload schema

occurred_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of event generation

producer.description: Service or module producing the event (e.g., vin_execution, vin_escrow)

aggregate_type.description: Aggregate root domain entity (e.g., Contract, Deliverable, EscrowAllocation)

aggregate_id.description: UUID of the domain aggregate root

correlation_id.description: End-to-end distributed trace and correlation identifier

causation_id.description: Event ID that directly triggered this event

idempotency_key.description: Unique key to ensure idempotent handling
